title: phase-1c data authoring: the versioned data sets
description:
Umbrella for the in-phase data-authoring work package named in the Decomposition section (ratified contract, phase 1c). Sets authored before phase 2a opens, landing as Layer 1 artifacts. Enumeration brought current 2026-07-20 with the chassis-affordance and attended/autonomous amendments (the original 13-item text predated them; contract governs):

(1) state schema with contents enumeration incl. published marker; (2) composition-scope domain and action vocabulary; (3) statusline data set — read-failure kinds with kind-to-action and recovery members (machine tokens + human text), degraded kinds with next-step text, wiring-outcome enumeration, per-field width budgets, wall-clock budget with flake-resistant timing-check shape; (4) failure-kind enumeration completed with abort and not-collected; (5) flake repetition number and per-test aggregation rule; (6) cannot-run predicate command binding and exit-and-timeout semantics; (7) mapping schema — confirm or override the adopted report-set default; (8) registered branch grammar — both registered forms with their refs-query seam; (9) autonomous-dispatch preflight members with each member's observation binding, the three-valued result semantics, and the dispatch-failed classification's fencing rule; (10) dispatch-manifest schema — the recording fields Recorded review dispatch enumerates, shipped as versioned data so parity queries read manifests as data; (11) effort-scaling signal catalog and tier-and-effort defaults; (12) mutation floor; (13) token budgets and calibration bands; (14) preset contents; (15) statusline and prompt copy incl. the benign-offline vs broken-state word distinction; (16) installed-artifact manifest schema with lifetime-half and reference-surface fields, PLUS this repo's populated manifest instance — authored ahead of the Layer 0 repair close (act 9), which verifies against it; (17) act-to-affordance map with its recorded swarm condition; (18) snapshot schema audit against the full Status integrity-query list plus renderer display fields.

Child issues per set as authoring runs; operator authorship where the oracle rule requires it (all judgment numbers are proposals until operator adoption is recorded). The statusline numbers resolve the routed items of 'phase-1c work item: statusline wiring script shape' (#362).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: PACKAGE OPENED (2026-07-20, attended session; phase issue #597). Proposed authoring order, clustered by dependency and decision-weight — operator confirmation or reorder welcome: ROUND 1 — item 16, installed-artifact manifest schema + this repo's populated instance (self-contained; evidence in hand from the hollow-shell audit; unblocks Layer 0 act 9's verification). ROUND 2 — item 1, state schema (foundational; everything references it); then item 2, composition-scope domain + action vocabulary (convergence-test inputs). ROUND 3 — the statusline cluster: items 3 + 15, resolving #362's four routed findings (width budgets, wall-clock budget, repo-set configuration, composition-instruction conduct); carries operator-owned numbers. ROUND 4 — the gate cluster: items 4, 5, 6, 7 (failure kinds, flake repetition + aggregation, cannot-run predicate binding, mapping schema default confirmation); operator-owned numbers and one adopted-default decision. ROUND 5 — the dispatch cluster: items 8, 9, 10, 17 (branch grammar, preflight members with observation bindings honestly reflecting the container-posture blockage recorded on #597, dispatch-manifest schema, act-to-affordance map with the swarm condition recorded as conditional). ROUND 6 — the economics cluster: items 11, 12, 13, 14 (effort signals + defaults, mutation floor, token budgets + calibration bands, presets); the heaviest operator-owned set — every number a proposal until adoption. CLOSE — item 18, the snapshot schema audit (requires items 1-3 landed). Conduct: each set drafted as a proposal artifact, walked through interactively for the operator-owned members, then the spec-review loop runs over the authored sets per the contract's phase-1c composition; every set lands as a child issue with owner and validator.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: PACKAGE COMPLETE, 2026-07-20: all eighteen contract items authored, operator-walked, and landed as nine validated artifact pairs across seven commits — the installed-artifact manifest with this repo's instance (#658), the state schema (#665), the composition scope and action vocabulary (#666), the statusline data resolving #362 (#667), the gate data (#668), the dispatch data (#669), the act-to-affordance map (#670), the economics data (#671), and the audited snapshot schema (#672). Every set shipped as registry artifact + mdatron schema, validated at pre-commit; the pair rule caught three real authoring defects across the landings (the flow-map comma class, rounds 2 and 3). All judgment numbers and copy carry recorded operator adoptions on their set issues; all sets remain draft-proposal pending the spec-review loop and the phase-exit adoption. Remaining before phase exit per the contract: the spec-review loop over the authored sets under the phase-1c composition, the documentation-reviewer cold pass, operator sign-off, the boundary commit — plus the parked Layer 0 residue (#656/#657 bundle, the operator substrate-setup acts, act 9's verification against the now-landed manifest instance, and #663's Solution Owner reading). Layer 0 act 9 note: the manifest instance this close requires is landed; the repair-close verification can now run.
